offers_products.reason: Leases office space in properties it owns; no goods or software sold as main offering.

offers_services.reason: Office REIT owning, managing and operating Class A buildings, leasing space to tenants; REITs count as services.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Tenants are corporate office users leasing space in Class A office towers.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Leases office space to businesses, including large corporate users, in Atlanta, Dallas and Orlando.

recurring_revenue.reason: Rental income from multi-year office leases across roughly 16 million square feet.

cyclical_demand.reason: Office tenants can downsize, delay leasing or not renew in downturns; remote work pressures demand.

big_ticket.reason: Tenants pay recurring monthly rent under leases, not a single large purchase.

people_delivered.reason: Revenue comes from owned office properties and rent, not staff time.

large_customers.reason: Tenants in large Class A towers include large corporate users.

asset_heavy.reason: Office REIT owning about 16 million square feet of properties needing ongoing capital for redevelopment and upgrades.
